scenario: AITA - For not extending a specific invitation to two nieces for an annual family event that everyone is invited to? | Every year, on the last day of March, we gather as a family to celebrate my father-in-law’s life at a specific restaurant. He passed away many years ago, and that was his favorite place to eat. My mother-in-law foots the bill as part of the celebration and everyone in the family that can attend is always welcome. Sometimes people bring friends and it is never a big deal and we all celebrate a great man. This year, we had 3 of the 4 of my mother-in-law’s kids and their families come and had a wonderful time. It is an open invitation, and she and all her children are adults with working phones. AITA for not reaching out to them and explicitly inviting them? Or should they know they are welcome (since they have been every other year) and take the initiative to just come? I didn’t get an invite and I showed up, so maybe IATA for a different reason.
